overview: The Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee approved the City Council's monthly newsletter with revisions. The committee also voted to send a set of inquiry questions to the mayor and department heads to evaluate staff capacity and data availability for a potential municipal open data policy.

items.title: Monthly Council Newsletter
items.summary: The committee reviewed and approved the draft monthly City Council newsletter with several text and scheduling edits.

items.title: Open Data Policy Development
items.summary: The committee discussed establishing a citywide open data policy and voted to submit survey questions to the administration regarding departmental data sets, staff capacity, and cost considerations.
